title: Payment and Profile Editing Improvements

sections.name: Checkout
items: Brava now selects Credit/Debit Card before filling payment details.
Card number, security code, expiration month, and expiration year are filled after the payment form appears.

sections.name: Editing
items: The task editor now provides more space for grouped profile and proxy selection.
Profiles can now be opened and edited individually with Shipping, Billing, and Card tabs.

instructions: Open Brava, go to Settings, check for updates, then select Update & restart.
